description:
A case arm (BackendEntryOrigin::Branch), a receive outcome and a handler get one lane per parameter: entry_signature (src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs) uses reprs_of and never consults a layout, bind_entry_input is a bind_runtime_value loop, and an outcome parameter has no TransportPosition::Value, so executable.abi.value_layouts has no entry for it. Captures of the same entries and DeliveredResume payloads are already read through a BackendValueLayout.

Change: every outcome parameter has a layout from layout_from_demand (first try the layout its origin already aliases, TransportOrigin::OutcomeSubject, so no new fact is derived). entry_signature, bind_entry_input, the outcome handoff in lower_control_dispatch_node (encode_runtime_value_for_layout), lower_entry_fn and mark_entry_function_params read parameters through that layout, and the interpreter's enter_entry binds through it. Assert that an outcome's arguments are in the entry's parameter order. The Whole floor on a handed subject stays in this step, so every layout is one lane and no program changes.

Removed: the one-lane-per-parameter path for entries (reprs_of use in entry_signature, the bind_runtime_value loop), leaving one way to read an entry's inputs.

Predictions: every fixture output unchanged on interp, run and build; case-walk probe still 10,175 bitstring allocations; distiller instructions and cycles unchanged. Derivation and reads pins: measure; a rise needs the user's authorization with numbers.

Done when: no entry origin has a parameter path that bypasses its layout; gate green; pins reported.

Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.cursor-fold.html (approved by the user 2026-11-15: remove special cases; what is no longer needed is fully removed).
title: An entry's parameters are laid out by demand
